## Why it matters internationally

The Zhu group is among the most-cited engineered-emissivity groups in
China, pushing selective thermal emitters toward scalability — the
bridge between laboratory metasurfaces and deployable radiative-cooling
materials.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** selective thermal emitters (engineered emissivity)
- **Spectral range:** solar + sky-window bands
- **Methodology:** Scalable selective thermal emitters for daytime and all-day radiative cooling (dual-selective emitter, Nature Communications 2024 — Tsinghua-led collaboration with Jia Zhu, NJU, as co-corresponding author); nanophotonics and nanoscale heat transfer.

**Application domains:** scalable radiative cooling · selective emitters.

## External sources
